name: Hafner Stub'n
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Hafner Stub'n in Tirol!**

Discover authentic Tyrolean charm in the heart of the Alps. Our cozy **Hafner Stub'n** invites you to savor traditional dishes like hearty **Kaiserschmarrn**, crispy **Speckknödel**, and rich **Tiroler Gröstl**, all paired with the finest local beers and crisp **Tiroler wines**.

Just a short stroll from **Innsbruck’s** Old Town, we offer a warm, rustic atmosphere where every visit feels like a homecoming. Whether you’re exploring the **Zillertal**, skiing in **St. Anton**, or simply unwinding after a day in the **Karwendel**, our **Stub’n** is your perfect retreat.

Come taste the soul of Tirol—one delicious bite at a time. **Prost!**
